pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, stellate dark regions with high-frequency, jagged edge gradients. The geometry is characterized by numerous sharp, acute-angled protrusions extending into the lighter corridors, particularly on the mid-to-lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A complex topological web of light-colored negative space. Pathways exhibit variable pixel thickness and frequent multi-directional junction nodes, maintaining high continuity across the visible anatomical surface.

other_distinctive_markers: A significant green-tinted chromatic haze or lens flare is present over the central flank region, affecting color rendering but not the underlying structural geometry of the pelage.
